plans.prompt: First-person point of view, close-up on a hand in a dark suit sleeve resting on a computer mouse on a dark wooden desk, cold blue-white monitor glow on the skin. The hand presses the mouse button once, firmly. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

A clean white public service hall in bright morning light. A woman in plain gray clothes stands at a sleek white kiosk; a plain blank white card slides out of its slot and she takes it and smiles calmly. Behind her, an orderly line of people in similar plain clothes waits in perfect spacing. No logos, no readable text anywhere. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, film grain.

Wide static shot at dawn: a tall, perfectly smooth white wall runs in a straight line across rolling green hills into the distance. Soft golden mist, no people, no flags, no symbols, no text on the wall. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Symmetrical shot down a straight suburban street of identical small white houses with identical perfectly trimmed green lawns. Children in identical plain navy school uniforms walk in a single orderly line along the sidewalk, all at the same pace. No flags, no logos, no text. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Frontal static shot of a schoolyard in morning light: rows of children in identical plain navy uniforms stand in perfect formation, each with the right hand on the chest, all singing in unison. There is no flag and no flagpole anywhere in frame, no banners, no symbols, no text. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Slow aerial push-in over the flat roof of a white school building completely covered by neat rows of dark solar panels gleaming in the morning sun, green trees around. No people, no logos, no text. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on an old beige CRT computer monitor on a dark wooden desk at night; its screen glows brighter and brighter, intense cold blue-white light flooding over two still hands in dark suit sleeves resting in front of it. No readable text on screen. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

View from inside a dark presidential office toward a tall window at dawn; the camera slowly moves toward the glass. Outside, a pristine white city with perfectly straight tree-lined avenues stretches to the horizon. The desk and the person at it are not visible, only the window frame in the foreground. No flags, no text. Cinematic, slow push-in, soft dawn light, film grain.

High wide shot of a perfectly symmetrical white city avenue lined with identical green trees. A sleek white train glides silently along an elevated track down the exact center of the avenue. Very few people, all walking at the same pace. No logos, no text, no flags. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Low angle in a clean white city plaza: several small smooth white drones hover motionless in a perfect grid formation in the clear blue sky above the rooftops, then all turn slowly in unison. No logos, no text, no flags. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

A large orderly crowd in plain light-colored clothes stands in a clean white city square, everyone looking down at their phones at the same time; all phone screens glow the same soft green, lighting their hands. No flags, no banners, no readable text. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

A giant blank screen on the white facade of a building above a city square suddenly switches on and glows solid bright green, the green light washing over the orderly crowd below seen from behind. No readable text, no symbols, no flags. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, film grain.

Frontal symmetrical shot of a family of four sitting at a white dinner table in a spotless white dining room, plates of identical food in front of them. All four sit perfectly upright, motionless, with the same calm fixed smile; no one speaks or eats. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Slow push-in on a large framed portrait hanging centered on a spotless white dining room wall. The portrait is completely out of focus, a blurred dark figure seen from behind, no face visible, no text. In the foreground, the sharp edge of a white dinner table. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, clean bright even lighting, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Frontal static shot of the facade of a large white apartment block at dusk: every single window lights up warm at exactly the same moment. No people visible, no text. Cinematic, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

A clean white city sidewalk in daylight: a dozen pedestrians in plain light-colored clothes walking in different directions all stop walking at exactly the same instant and stand perfectly still. No text, no logos. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Frontal static shot of a bright white classroom: rows of children in identical plain navy uniforms all raise their right hands at exactly the same moment. The front of the room is not visible. No text, no flags. Cinematic, clean bright even lighting, symmetrical composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Aerial shot rising slowly above a perfectly symmetrical white city at sunset, straight green avenues radiating from a central circular plaza, warm golden light. No flags, no text. Cinematic, slow upward movement, clean composition, slightly uncanny stillness, film grain.

Very high aerial shot at sunset, still rising: an entire orderly country of green fields, neat white towns and straight roads stretches to the curved horizon, a smooth white wall tracing the border in the distance. No flags, no text. Cinematic, slow upward movement, warm golden light, film grain.

First-person point of view: two hands in dark suit sleeves rest completely motionless on a dark wooden desk in a dim presidential office at night, lit by the steady cold blue-white glow of an old beige CRT monitor just out of frame. Rain on the window behind. Nothing moves. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Extreme close-up on the same two hands resting perfectly still on the dark wooden desk, steady cold blue-white monitor glow on the skin; the light slowly dims toward darkness while the hands do not move at all. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.
